name: 日常
description: 日常生活中的常用口语句子，按情景、场景、话题分类。

examples.en: Hello, I'm Anna.
Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too.
Hi, I'm new here.
My name is David.
Please call me Ben.
Are you Mr. Smith?
Sorry, what was your name again?
examples.zh: 不好意思，你叫什么来着？

examples.en: How do you spell your name?
How do you do?
Are you a friend of Tom's?
How do you know Sarah?
examples.zh: 你和莎拉是怎么认识的？

examples.en: Is this your first time here?
This is my first day here.
examples.zh: 今天是我来这里的第一天。

examples.en: I don't think we've met.
Sorry, I didn't catch your name.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我没听清你的名字。

examples.en: It's a pleasure to meet you.
I've heard a lot about you.
Have we met before? You look familiar.
examples.zh: 我们以前见过吗？你看着眼熟。

examples.en: Sorry, I'm terrible with names.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我很不擅长记名字。

examples.en: It's great to finally meet you in person.
examples.zh: 终于见到你本人了，太好了。

examples.en: Let me introduce myself. I'm Tom's sister.
examples.zh: 我先自我介绍一下，我是汤姆的姐姐。

examples.en: Do you go by Katherine or Kate?
examples.zh: 你习惯别人叫你凯瑟琳还是凯特？

examples.en: I feel like I already know you from all of Emma's stories.
examples.zh: 听艾玛讲了你那么多事，我觉得好像早就认识你了。

examples.en: Hi! How are you?
I'm fine, thanks. And you?
Good morning!
Good to see you.
Not bad, thanks.
How's it going?
Pretty good. How about you?
What's up?
Not much. Just the usual.
How's your day going?
I'm a bit tired today.
How's your family?
Busy as usual.
Are you feeling better today?
You look great today!
examples.zh: 你今天看起来气色真好！

examples.en: Can't complain.
I've been really busy lately.
Hey, where are you off to?
Is everything all right? You seem a bit quiet.
examples.zh: 一切还好吗？你看起来有点沉默。

examples.en: Did you get here okay in all that rain?
examples.zh: 下那么大的雨，你过来还顺利吗？

examples.en: I'm hanging in there.
Things have been a bit hectic, but I'm getting there.
examples.zh: 最近有点手忙脚乱，不过慢慢好起来了。

examples.en: Long time no see!
Wow, is that you?
It's me, Jenny!
How are your kids?
How have you been?
When did we last see each other?
examples.zh: 我们上次见面是什么时候？

examples.en: Are you still living in London?
Are you still working at the bank?
I missed you!
We should meet more often.
I almost didn't recognize you!
What have you been up to?
examples.zh: 你这段时间都在忙些什么？

examples.en: You haven't changed a bit!
It must be at least five years.
The last time I saw you, you were still in school.
examples.zh: 我上次见你的时候，你还在上学呢。

examples.en: What a surprise to run into you here!
examples.zh: 真没想到会在这里碰到你！

examples.en: I heard you got married. Congratulations!
Are you still in touch with anyone from school?
examples.zh: 你还和学校里的人有联系吗？

examples.en: Time flies, doesn't it?
I've been meaning to get in touch for ages.
examples.zh: 我一直想联系你，拖了好久。

examples.en: Let's not let so much time go by next time.
Goodbye!
Bye! See you tomorrow.
See you later.
Have a nice day!
Good night.
See you next week.
Take care.
I have to go now.
It was nice talking to you.
Have a good weekend!
Say hi to your mom for me.
Call me when you get home.
Have a safe trip.
Get home safe.
Sorry, I'd better get going.
It was great seeing you again.
Let's keep in touch.
Let's get together again sometime.
I'll text you about next week.
examples.zh: 下周的事我发消息给你。

examples.en: Don't be a stranger!
Thanks for having me.
Drop me a line when you're back.
I'm afraid I have to head out.
I'd love to stay longer, but I have an early start tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我很想多待会儿，可我明天一早就得出门。

examples.en: How was your weekend?
It was great, thanks.
What did you do on Saturday?
I stayed at home.
I went to the beach.
Did you do anything fun?
Not much, I just relaxed.
examples.zh: 没做什么，就是休息了一下。

examples.en: Any plans for the weekend?
I'm going to visit my parents.
Where did you go on vacation?
We went camping.
The weekend went too fast.
Are you going away this summer?
I didn't do much, to be honest.
I'm looking forward to the long weekend.
I spent the whole day in the garden.
examples.zh: 我在花园里待了一整天。

examples.en: We're thinking of going to the mountains.
How was the trip? Did you get any sun?
examples.zh: 旅行怎么样？晒到太阳了吗？

examples.en: I need a vacation after that vacation!
examples.zh: 度完那个假，我还得再度个假！

examples.en: Are you doing anything nice for the holidays?
I'm off next week, so I'm hoping to catch up on some sleep.
examples.zh: 我下周休假，希望能补补觉。

examples.en: It was nice to have a quiet one for a change.
examples.zh: 难得清静地过了一个周末，挺好的。

examples.en: It's a nice day today.
It's very hot today.
It's cold!
It's raining again.
Is it going to rain?
What's the weather like today?
What's the weather going to be like tomorrow?
It's going to snow this weekend.
Don't forget your umbrella.
It's really windy out there.
It's a bit cloudy.
I hope it stays sunny.
The sun's finally out!
Nice weather, isn't it?
It looks like it's going to rain.
The forecast says it'll clear up later.
examples.zh: 天气预报说晚点会转晴。

examples.en: It's supposed to be warmer tomorrow.
I got caught in the rain on the way here.
It's so humid today.
What a miserable day!
You'd better take a jacket; it's chilly.
examples.zh: 你最好带件外套，有点凉。

examples.en: They say there's a storm on the way.
It's absolutely pouring out there.
I like summer.
Winter is very cold here.
What's your favorite season?
It snows a lot in January.
Spring is the best time to visit.
examples.zh: 春天是来玩的最好时节。

examples.en: Does it snow much here?
It's much warmer than last year.
The summers here are very hot and dry.
I don't like the rainy season.
The leaves change color in autumn.
The days are getting shorter.
There's a typhoon coming this weekend.
Schools are closed because of the snow.
I can't stand the heat in August.
Winters here are getting milder every year.
examples.zh: 这里的冬天一年比一年暖和。

examples.en: There was a flood in the town last year.
Make sure you drink plenty of water in this heat.
examples.zh: 这么热的天一定要多喝水。

examples.en: What's the climate like where you're from?
The roads are icy, so drive carefully.
It's unusually warm for this time of year.
examples.zh: 每年这个时候很少这么暖和。

examples.en: The heat wave is supposed to last until the weekend.
examples.zh: 这波热浪据说要持续到周末。

examples.en: I'm not used to such long, dark winters.
examples.zh: 我不习惯这么漫长又昏暗的冬天。

examples.en: I'm from China.
Where are you from?
I'm Chinese.
My English name is Kevin.
I live in Shanghai.
My family name is Wang.
Which city are you from?
I was born in Ohio, but I live in Texas now.
examples.zh: 我出生在俄亥俄州，现在住在得克萨斯州。

examples.en: Where is that?
It's in the south of China.
It's a small city near Hangzhou.
examples.zh: 是杭州附近的一个小城市。

examples.en: How do you pronounce your name?
What does your name mean?
My name means "bright" in Chinese.
examples.zh: 我的名字在中文里是“明亮”的意思。

examples.en: My parents chose it because I was born in spring.
examples.zh: 我爸妈起这个名字是因为我出生在春天。

examples.en: In China, the family name comes first.
I've lived here for about three years.
examples.zh: 我在这儿住了大约三年了。

examples.en: Originally I'm from the north, but I moved here for work.
examples.zh: 我老家在北方，后来为了工作搬到这里。

examples.en: Most people just call me by my nickname.
examples.zh: 大多数人就叫我的小名。

examples.en: I was named after my grandfather.
examples.zh: 我的名字是随我爷爷取的。

examples.en: It's a common name where I'm from, so there were three of us in my class.
examples.zh: 这在我老家是个常见的名字，我们班上就有三个。

examples.en: I have one younger sister.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
My parents live in Chengdu.
Are you married?
Yes, and we have a little boy.
I'm an only child.
I grew up in a small town near the sea.
examples.zh: 我在海边的一个小镇长大。

examples.en: What's your hometown like?
It's quiet and very green.
examples.zh: 那里很安静，到处绿树成荫。

examples.en: My hometown is famous for its food.
I go back home twice a year.
Do you live with your parents?
My brother is two years older than me.
I miss my hometown sometimes.
I'm the youngest of three.
examples.zh: 我是家里三个孩子中最小的。

examples.en: We're a very close family.
My grandparents brought me up.
It's changed a lot since I was a kid.
examples.zh: 从我小时候到现在，那里变化很大。

examples.en: There isn't much to do there, but the people are friendly.
examples.zh: 那里没什么好玩的，但人很友善。

examples.en: If you ever go there, you should try the noodles.
examples.zh: 要是你去那儿，一定得尝尝那里的面。

examples.en: My parents still live in the house I grew up in.
examples.zh: 我父母还住在我从小长大的房子里。

examples.en: Most of my relatives are still back home, so I don't see them very often.
examples.zh: 我大部分亲戚还在老家，所以不常见面。

examples.en: What do you do?
I'm a teacher.
I'm a student.
I work in an office.
What do you study?
I work for a small IT company.
examples.zh: 我在一家小 IT 公司工作。

examples.en: I'm in my second year.
I'm a nurse at the city hospital.
I work from home most days.
examples.zh: 我大多数时候在家办公。

examples.en: How long have you worked there?
Do you like your job?
I'm looking for a job at the moment.
It's hard work, but I enjoy it.
examples.zh: 工作很辛苦，但我很喜欢。

examples.en: What do you do for a living?
I just graduated last summer.
I'm retired now.
I'm studying economics in college.
I'm in sales.
I'm a software engineer, so I spend all day in front of a screen.
examples.zh: 我是软件工程师，所以一整天都对着屏幕。

examples.en: I've been working there for about five years.
examples.zh: 我在那里工作大概五年了。

examples.en: I'm doing a master's in engineering.
I run my own small business.
I'm between jobs right now.
I'm a freelance designer.
I'm hoping to move into marketing in a year or two.
examples.zh: 我希望一两年内转做市场营销。

examples.en: This is my friend, Lucy.
This is my wife, Mei.
Lucy, this is Tom.
Come and meet my parents.
Who's that?
Have you met my sister?
Do you two know each other?
This is Jack. We work together.
She's my best friend from school.
examples.zh: 她是我上学时最好的朋友。

examples.en: You two should talk. You both love music.
examples.zh: 你们俩该聊聊，你们都喜欢音乐。

examples.en: Sorry, I forgot to introduce you!
examples.zh: 抱歉，忘了给你们介绍了！

examples.en: Everyone, this is Sam.
Let me introduce you to my boss.
examples.zh: 我给你介绍一下我老板。

examples.en: He's the one I told you about.
examples.zh: 他就是我跟你提过的那个人。

examples.en: I'd like you to meet my colleague, Dr. Brown.
examples.zh: 我想让你见见我的同事，布朗博士。

examples.en: We've met before, actually.
Sarah's just moved here from Canada.
examples.zh: 莎拉刚从加拿大搬过来。

examples.en: Anna's the person to ask if you need help with your computer.
examples.zh: 如果电脑有问题，找安娜就对了。

examples.en: I don't think you've met my husband.
examples.zh: 你应该还没见过我丈夫吧。

examples.en: We go way back.
I've been wanting you two to meet for ages.
examples.zh: 我早就想让你们俩认识认识了。

examples.en: You've probably heard me talk about Jenny. She's the one who got me into running.
examples.zh: 你大概听我说起过珍妮，就是她带我开始跑步的。

examples.en: Sorry, what?
Pardon?
Again, please.
One more time, please.
Please speak slowly.
I don't understand.
Sorry, I don't speak English very well.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我英语说得不太好。

examples.en: Could you say that again, please?
Can you speak more slowly, please?
Sorry, I didn't hear you.
Could you speak a bit louder?
Can you write it down for me?
Sorry, it's very noisy in here.
Sorry, what did you say?
Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
Could you repeat the last part?
examples.zh: 最后那部分能再说一遍吗？

examples.en: You're speaking a bit too fast for me.
examples.zh: 你说得有点快，我跟不上。

examples.en: Sorry, I missed the first part.
examples.zh: 抱歉，前面那部分我没听到。

examples.en: Could you spell that for me?
Would you mind saying that again more slowly?
examples.zh: 您介意再慢慢说一遍吗？

examples.en: I'm still learning English, so please be patient with me.
examples.zh: 我还在学英语，请多包涵。

examples.en: Sorry, you lost me there.
I'm having trouble following. Could you go over it again?
examples.zh: 我有点跟不上，能再讲一遍吗？

examples.en: What does this word mean?
What's this called in English?
How do you say this in English?
How do you write it?
What does that mean?
How do you pronounce this word?
Can you give me an example?
Is it the same as "big"?
What's the difference between "look" and "see"?
Is it a polite word?
Can I say it like this?
Is there another word for it?
What do you call the thing you use to open bottles?
examples.zh: 开瓶子用的那个东西叫什么？

examples.en: Is that a word people use every day?
examples.zh: 人们日常会用这个词吗？

examples.en: Is it formal or informal?
examples.zh: 这是正式还是非正式的说法？

examples.en: Does it have a different meaning in American English?
examples.zh: 它在美式英语里意思不一样吗？

examples.en: What does it mean when someone says "I'm good"?
examples.zh: 别人说“I'm good”是什么意思？

examples.en: Would it sound strange if I said it that way?
examples.zh: 我那样说会不会听起来很奇怪？

examples.en: I've seen this word before, but I've forgotten what it means.
examples.zh: 这个词我见过，但忘了是什么意思。

examples.en: Does it have a negative meaning?
Is there a more natural way to say that?
What's the difference in tone between "sorry" and "excuse me"?
examples.zh: “sorry”和“excuse me”在语气上有什么区别？

examples.en: Is that right?
Do you mean this one?
So, at three?
Like this?
OK, I see.
Do you mean we should meet at six?
examples.zh: 你是说我们六点见面吗？

examples.en: So I need to go left, right?
Did you say Tuesday or Thursday?
examples.zh: 你说的是周二还是周四？

examples.en: Did you say fifteen or fifty?
examples.zh: 你说的是十五还是五十？

examples.en: Do you understand what I mean?
Sorry, is it this one or that one?
Got it, thanks.
Let me make sure I understand.
examples.zh: 我确认一下我理解得对不对。

examples.en: So what you're saying is the shop is closed today?
examples.zh: 所以你的意思是这家店今天关门？

examples.en: Just to check, the meeting is in room five, not three?
examples.zh: 确认一下，会议在五号房间，不是三号？

examples.en: Does that make sense?
Let me repeat that back to you.
Sorry, I'm not sure I follow.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我不太确定我听懂了。

examples.en: Are you with me so far?
Am I right in thinking the price includes breakfast?
examples.zh: 我理解的是价格包含早餐，对吗？

examples.en: If I've understood correctly, we don't need to book in advance.
examples.zh: 如果我理解得没错，我们不需要提前预订。

examples.en: Just so we're on the same page, you'll send the file by Friday?
examples.zh: 确认一下我们想的一样：你周五前把文件发过来？

examples.en: I don't know how to say it.
It's like this.
It's big and round.
It's a kind of bird.
It's red, and you can eat it.
I don't know the word, but it's a kind of fruit.
examples.zh: 我不知道这个词，不过它是一种水果。

examples.en: It's the thing you use to cut paper.
examples.zh: 就是用来剪纸的那个东西。

examples.en: It's a place where you can buy medicine.
It's similar to a cake, but smaller.
examples.zh: 它跟蛋糕差不多，不过小一些。

examples.en: How can I say this?
Can I show you a picture?
It's a person who fixes cars.
What I mean is, I need a little more time.
examples.zh: 我的意思是，我需要再多一点时间。

examples.en: Let me put it another way.
It's on the tip of my tongue.
examples.zh: 话到嘴边就是想不起来。

examples.en: It's hard to explain, but I'll try.
In other words, we're going to be late.
examples.zh: 换句话说，我们要迟到了。

examples.en: Sorry, that's not what I meant.
Sorry, my English isn't good enough to explain it.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我的英语不够好，解释不清楚。

examples.en: Basically, it's a sort of soup made with beans.
examples.zh: 简单说，就是一种用豆子做的汤。

examples.en: What I'm trying to say is that I'd rather not go.
examples.zh: 我想说的是，我宁愿不去。

examples.en: I can't think of the exact word, but it's something like a festival.
examples.zh: 我想不起确切的词，不过大概就是节日之类的东西。

examples.en: Thank you.
Thanks a lot.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.
No problem.
Thanks for your help.
Thanks anyway.
That's very kind of you.
It's my pleasure.
Thanks for everything.
Thank you for the lovely gift.
Thanks for coming.
Anytime.
Thanks, I really like it.
I really appreciate it.
You've been a great help.
Thanks for taking the time to see me.
I don't know how to thank you.
examples.zh: 我都不知道该怎么谢你才好。

examples.en: I owe you one.
Don't mention it.
Glad I could help.
Thanks for letting me know.
You really didn't have to do that.
I can't thank you enough for all your support.
examples.zh: 你的支持让我感激不尽。

examples.en: It was the least I could do.
Sorry!
I'm sorry.
I'm so sorry I'm late.
That's OK.
Oh, excuse me.
Oh, sorry, my mistake.
Sorry about that.
No worries.
Don't worry about it.
Sorry to bother you.
Sorry, I didn't mean to.
It doesn't matter.
Sorry for the mess.
Sorry, I forgot.
I'm really sorry. It won't happen again.
examples.zh: 真的很抱歉，不会再有下次了。

examples.en: I apologize for the delay.
Sorry for keeping you waiting.
It wasn't your fault.
Forget about it, it's fine.
Sorry, that was rude of me.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我刚才太没礼貌了。

examples.en: Apology accepted.
I feel terrible about what happened.
examples.zh: 发生这种事我很过意不去。

examples.en: I hope you can forgive me.
There's no need to apologize.
I owe you an apology.
I'm sorry if I came across as rude earlier.
examples.zh: 如果我刚才显得没礼貌，我很抱歉。

examples.en: Can you help me, please?
Can I ask you something?
Of course!
Sure, no problem.
Can you open the door, please?
Could you do me a favor?
Could you help me with these bags?
examples.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这些袋子吗？

examples.en: Could you pass me the salt?
Can I borrow your pen?
Sorry, I can't right now.
Can you wait a minute?
Would you mind holding the door for me?
Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Do you think you could give me a ride?
Of course, I'd be happy to.
I'd love to help, but I'm a bit busy right now.
examples.zh: 我很想帮忙，但现在有点忙。

examples.en: Let me know if there's anything I can do.
examples.zh: 有什么我能做的就告诉我。

examples.en: Not at all. Go ahead.
Is there any chance you could help me move on Saturday?
examples.zh: 你周六能不能帮我搬家？

examples.en: Sorry to be a pain, but could you check this for me?
examples.zh: 麻烦你了，能帮我检查一下这个吗？

examples.en: I wouldn't ask if it weren't important.
examples.zh: 要不是重要的事，我也不会麻烦你。

You can go first.
Please wait here.
Next, please!
Excuse me, I'm next.
Is this the end of the line?
Are you in line?
After you.
Excuse me, I was here first.
How long have you been waiting?
The line is really long today.
Is this the line for tickets?
Do I need to take a number?
Sorry, I didn't see you there.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我没看到你在排队。

Excuse me, the line starts back there.
Would you mind keeping my place? I'll be right back.
examples.zh: 你能帮我占个位吗？我马上回来。

examples.zh: 我觉得这位先生在我前面。

examples.zh: 我只买一样东西，能让我先吗？

examples.zh: 有票的人是另外排队吗？

examples.zh: 不好意思，你好像插队了。

examples.en: Some people just don't care about waiting their turn.
examples.zh: 有些人根本不在乎排队等。

Sit here, please.
Yes, it's free.
Would you like to sit down?
Please, take my seat.
Sorry, it's taken.
Could you move over a little?
Can we swap seats?

examples.zh: 这个座位我给朋友留的。

Do you mind if I sit next to you?
Would you mind moving your bag?
Could you move down one seat so we can sit together?
examples.zh: 你能往里挪一个座位，让我们坐在一起吗？

examples.en: These seats are for elderly and disabled passengers.
examples.zh: 这些座位是给老人和残障乘客的。

examples.en: Would you like my seat? You look tired.

examples.en: I said no.
No way!
It's my decision.
I really mean it.
You can't make me.

examples.zh: 如果是别的事我就算了，但这次不行。

I can live with that.

I don't love the idea, but I'll go along with it.
examples.zh: 我不太喜欢这主意，但我会配合。

examples.zh: 我们先试一个月看看效果。

examples.zh: 我愿意妥协，但你也得让一步。

examples.zh: 我们都不可能完全如愿，现实一点吧。

I was wrong.
I didn't mean it.
I'm sorry too.
I hate fighting with you.
Can you forgive me?
I'm sorry I lost my temper.
I shouldn't have said that.
I should have listened to you.
Can we start over?
Let's forget about it and move on.
examples.zh: 我们忘了这件事往前看吧。

I've been thinking about what you said.
It's fine. I've already forgotten about it.

Let's not let this come between us.
examples.zh: 别让这件事影响我们的关系。

examples.en: I owe you an apology. I was completely out of line.
examples.zh: 我欠你一个道歉，我完全过分了。

examples.en: Let's put it behind us. Life's too short.
examples.zh: 过去就过去吧，人生苦短。

examples.en: I hope this doesn't change things between us.
examples.zh: 希望这不会改变我们之间的关系。

What would you do if you were me?
examples.zh: 如果你是我，你会怎么做？

examples.en: Be honest. What do you really think?
examples.zh: 说实话，你真实的想法是什么？

examples.zh: 我需要一些关于我男朋友的建议。

examples.zh: 我决定不了是留还是走。

examples.zh: 如果我反应过度就告诉我。

examples.zh: 这事我已经反复纠结好几周了。

examples.en: I'd really value your opinion, since you know us both.
examples.zh: 你认识我们俩，我很看重你的意见。

examples.en: Talk to her.
Don't do it.
Just be yourself.
You should see a doctor.
Try to get some sleep.

Why don't you take a short break?

examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会直接跟他谈。

examples.zh: 你最好在别人告诉他之前先说。

examples.zh: 先写下来可能是个好主意。

examples.zh: 你总可以要求多给点时间。

examples.zh: 你自己决定，但我个人会再给一次机会。

examples.zh: 如果一个月后还困扰你，那就值得采取行动。

examples.zh: 不管你怎么决定，要确保是你想要的，而不是别人期望的。

I feel better now.

I'm glad I asked you.
I'll let you know how it goes.

examples.en: I only caught a glimpse of him, so I can't be sure.
examples.zh: 我只瞥了他一眼，不能确定。

examples.en: There's a camera above the store, so it may have been recorded.
examples.zh: 商店上方有摄像头，可能录下来了。

examples.en: My doorbell camera might have caught it.
examples.zh: 我家门铃摄像头可能拍到了。

examples.en: I saw it.

examples.en: Do I need a lawyer?
Is there anything else you remember?

Here's your case number.

examples.zh: 我们可能需要你回来指认他。

examples.en: You're not in any trouble. We just need to know what you saw.
examples.zh: 你没有麻烦，我们只需要知道你看到了什么。

examples.en: Try to describe it in as much detail as you can, even if it seems unimportant.
examples.zh: 尽可能详细地描述，即使看起来不重要。

examples.en: Did you find him?
Did you find my bike?
examples.zh: 你们找到我的自行车了吗？

examples.en: Can I get my things back?

I haven't heard anything for weeks.
examples.zh: 我好几周没听到任何消息了。

examples.en: I remembered something else about the man.
examples.zh: 我又想起了关于那个人的一些事。

examples.en: Your phone was found, and you can pick it up.
examples.zh: 你的手机找到了，可以来取。

examples.en: Is there a number I can call for updates?
examples.zh: 有能查询进展的电话吗？

examples.en: We arrested someone, but we need you to confirm a few details.
examples.zh: 我们抓到了一个人，但需要你确认一些细节。

examples.en: The case has been closed because there isn't enough evidence.
examples.zh: 因为证据不足，案件已结案。

examples.en: I understand you're busy, but this has really affected my family.
examples.zh: 我理解你们很忙，但这事真的影响了我的家人。

examples.en: We'll keep the case open in case new information comes in.
examples.zh: 我们会保留案件，以防有新线索。

examples.en: You may be able to get compensation as a victim of a crime.
examples.zh: 作为犯罪受害者，你可能可以获得赔偿。

examples.en: Please hurry!

Is the person awake?
How old is the patient?

examples.zh: 有人受伤了，我们需要救护车。

examples.zh: 这里是 911，有什么紧急情况？

examples.en: Help is on the way.
Has she taken anything?

examples.zh: 我觉得他心脏病发作了。

examples.en: Please stay calm and answer my questions.
examples.zh: 请保持冷静，回答我的问题。

examples.en: Don't move him unless you have to.
My father collapsed, and he isn't responding.
examples.zh: 我父亲倒下了，没有反应。

My wife is pregnant, and she's in a lot of pain.
examples.zh: 我妻子怀孕了，疼得厉害。

examples.zh: 在急救人员到达前，我会指导你怎么做。

examples.zh: 附近有除颤器吗？需要有人去拿。

examples.en: Keep pressing hard on the wound to stop the bleeding.
examples.zh: 持续用力按住伤口止血。

examples.zh: 我们在主街和第五大道的拐角。

examples.en: The ambulance is on its way. Stay on the line.
examples.zh: 救护车在路上了，请别挂断。

examples.en: What's the address of your emergency?
examples.zh: 出事地点的地址是哪里？

examples.en: I'll send you my location.
We're in the park, near the lake.
examples.zh: 我们在公园里，靠近湖边。

It's a blue door next to the pharmacy.
We're on the highway, just past exit four.
examples.zh: 我们在高速上，刚过四号出口。

examples.en: Turn on the porch light so they can find you.
examples.zh: 打开门廊灯，让他们找得到你。

examples.en: Please unlock the front door for the paramedics.
examples.zh: 请为急救人员打开前门。

examples.en: The elevator isn't working, so they'll need to come up the stairs.
examples.zh: 电梯坏了，他们得走楼梯上来。

examples.en: There's no address. We're on a hiking trail about a mile from the parking lot.
examples.zh: 没有地址，我们在离停车场约一英里的步道上。

examples.en: He's hurt.
There's a lot of blood.
He hit his head.
She burned her hand.
I can't move my leg.
His arm looks broken.
He's bleeding badly from his head.
She's breathing, but she's not awake.
Can you squeeze my hand?
She's thrown up several times.
He has a deep cut on his hand.
examples.zh: 他手上有一道很深的伤口。

examples.en: She's having an allergic reaction.
His face has gone really pale.
He's conscious, but he's very confused.
Try not to move until we check your neck.
examples.zh: 在我们检查你的脖子前尽量别动。

examples.en: On a scale of one to ten, how bad is the pain?
examples.zh: 从一到十，疼痛有多严重？

examples.en: She's diabetic, so it might be her blood sugar.
examples.zh: 她有糖尿病，可能是血糖问题。

examples.en: He was knocked out for about a minute, and now he can't remember what happened.
examples.zh: 他昏过去大约一分钟，现在不记得发生了什么。

examples.en: We need to take you to the hospital to get an X-ray.
examples.zh: 我们需要送你去医院拍 X 光。

examples.en: Where's the emergency room?
Is she going to be OK?
Can I stay with him?
It's getting worse.
What brings you in today?

Please take a seat and wait to be called.
Do you have your insurance card?

We need to run a few tests.
We see the most serious cases first.
examples.zh: 我们先看最严重的病人。

We've been waiting for over three hours.
examples.zh: 我们已经等了三个多小时。

examples.en: Please tell us if the pain gets worse.
Only one person can go back with the patient.
examples.zh: 只能有一人陪同病人进去。

examples.en: He's stable now, but we'd like to keep him overnight for observation.
examples.zh: 他现在情况稳定，但我们想让他留院观察一晚。

examples.en: If it's not an emergency, you'll probably be seen faster at urgent care.
examples.zh: 如果不是急症，去急诊诊所可能更快。

examples.en: We'll let you know as soon as the scan results come back.
examples.zh: 扫描结果一出来我们就通知你。

Get out now!

Don't open the door!
Is anyone still inside?

Stay low. The smoke is really thick.
The fire trucks are on their way.
I think it started in the garage.
examples.zh: 我觉得是从车库开始着的。

Never throw water on a grease fire.
There's smoke coming out of a second-floor window.
Luckily, no one was hurt, but the kitchen was badly damaged.
examples.zh: 幸好没人受伤，但厨房损坏严重。

examples.zh: 每月测试烟雾报警器，确保正常工作。

examples.en: Feel the door before you open it. If it's hot, don't go out that way.
examples.zh: 开门前先摸一下，如果烫就别从那边走。

examples.en: This way, everyone!
Don't run.
Where's the nearest exit?
Leave your things.
Wait here until it's safe.
Use the stairs, not the elevator.
Follow the exit signs.
Everyone, please leave the building calmly.
examples.zh: 请大家冷静地离开大楼。

Help the elderly and children first.
Hold the handrail and walk slowly.
Don't go back inside for any reason.
We need to make sure everyone's out.
examples.zh: 我们需要确认所有人都出来了。

examples.en: Keep the road clear for the fire trucks.
Please go to the meeting point in the parking lot.
You can go back in now. It was a false alarm.
examples.zh: 现在可以回去了，是误报。

examples.en: If anyone is missing, tell the firefighters right away.
examples.zh: 如果有人不见了，马上告诉消防员。

examples.en: Wherever you stay, make sure you know where the fire exits are.
examples.zh: 无论住在哪里，都要清楚消防出口在哪儿。

examples.en: Don't stop to take videos until you're safely out of the building.
examples.zh: 安全离开大楼前别停下来拍视频。

It wasn't my fault.
Did you see what happened?
I didn't see the other car.
He drove into the back of my car.
A car just hit my bike from behind.
examples.zh: 一辆车从后面撞了我的自行车。

examples.en: Let's move the cars to the side of the road.
Take pictures of the damage.
Turn on your hazard lights.
He ran a red light.
Do we need to call the police?
Is anyone else in the car?
Let's exchange insurance information.
examples.zh: 我们交换一下保险信息。

examples.en: The other driver drove off without stopping.
examples.zh: 另一个司机没停车就跑了。

examples.en: I hit the brakes, but I couldn't stop in time.
examples.zh: 我踩了刹车，但没来得及停住。

examples.en: Your insurance should pay for the repairs.
examples.zh: 你的保险应该能赔修理费。

examples.en: My neck started hurting a few hours after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故几小时后我的脖子开始疼。

examples.en: Don't admit it was your fault, even if you're not sure what happened.
examples.zh: 即使不确定发生了什么，也别承认是你的错。

examples.en: It was just a fender bender, so we didn't need to call the police.
examples.zh: 只是轻微剐蹭，所以我们没报警。

examples.en: I lost my bag.
I can't find my keys.
Where's the lost and found?
I lost it this morning.
I left my umbrella on the bus.
examples.zh: 我把伞落在公交车上了。

examples.en: I think I left it at the café.
examples.zh: 我想我把它落在咖啡馆了。

examples.en: I lost my wallet somewhere on this train.
examples.zh: 我把钱包丢在这趟火车上了。

examples.zh: 如果找到了我们会给你打电话。

examples.en: Could you check the bus I was on?
examples.zh: 你能查一下我坐的那辆公交车吗？

examples.en: You can file a lost item report online.
examples.zh: 你可以在网上登记失物。

examples.en: We keep items here for thirty days.
examples.zh: 物品在这里保留三十天。

examples.zh: 是八点一刻从波士顿开出的火车。

examples.en: I had it when I got on, but not when I got off.
examples.zh: 上车时还在，下车时就没了。

examples.en: I've gone back the way I came, but I can't find it.
examples.zh: 我沿原路找了一遍，但没找到。

examples.en: It's not worth much, but it means a lot to me.
examples.zh: 它不值什么钱，但对我意义重大。

examples.en: I'd given up hope of ever seeing it again.
examples.zh: 我已经不指望能再找到它了。

examples.en: Have you tried calling the restaurant to see if they found it?
examples.zh: 你打电话问过餐厅有没有找到吗？

examples.en: It might take a couple of days for items to get to the main office.
examples.zh: 物品送到总部可能需要几天。

examples.zh: 钱包里有我的卡和证件。

examples.en: It's a gold ring with a small stone.
examples.zh: 是一枚镶着小宝石的金戒指。

examples.en: There's a scratch on the back of the phone.

examples.zh: 是个黑色背包，里面有笔记本电脑。

examples.zh: 我可以告诉你锁屏上是什么。

examples.zh: 它挺旧的，有一个拉链坏了。

examples.zh: 里面有一封写着我地址的信。

examples.zh: 戒指内侧刻着我名字的首字母。

examples.zh: 是一把很普通的黑伞，可能很难辨认。

examples.zh: 你能描述一下里面能证明是你的东西吗？

Who found it?
Is this umbrella yours?
Please sign for it here.
When can I pick it up?
Is everything still inside?
Can you prove that this is yours?

examples.zh: 有人找到了你的伞，你可以来这儿取。

examples.zh: 我可以解锁手机证明是我的。

examples.zh: 真不敢相信有人还回来了。

examples.zh: 找到它的人一定很诚实。

examples.zh: 三十天内无人认领的物品会捐给慈善机构。

It was on the floor.
Where should I take it?

examples.zh: 有人把这个落在这儿了。

examples.zh: 打扰一下，你忘了你的包！

examples.zh: 我在长椅上捡到这部手机。

examples.zh: 需要我的姓名和电话吗？

examples.zh: 我打一下手机上最后一个号码。

examples.zh: 我想追上他，但他已经走了。

examples.zh: 里面有证件，我们可以联系失主。

examples.zh: 大家下车后我在座位上发现的。

examples.zh: 我不想就这么放着，以免被别人拿走。

examples.zh: 我在网上发了照片，以防失主看到。

examples.zh: 我捡到一串钥匙，但不知道是谁的。
